name: G超起始牌組「眾星雲集組合篇」
englishName: GX Starter Deck: All Stars Collection

description.text: GX Starter Deck: All Stars Collection, sold as the Traditional Chinese edition of the game first arrived: a random 60-card deck, ready to play, with damage counters, GX markers and a rule book; each deck always held one Pokémon-GX, along with Trainer cards often played in battles. This set holds every card the decks could contain.
